errors.description: i2c_shadow_q is a multi-bit value produced in i2c_clk and sampled directly in cfg_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
stop_pulse_q is a one-cycle i2c_clk pulse consumed directly in cfg_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
stop_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample cfg_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in cfg_event_o.
bank_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector bank_q before decoding in cfg_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
i2c_rst_n is used as data inside cfg_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
sys_snapshot_q combines i2c_clk payload state with cfg_clk status state in sys_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
